response.justification: While Bogdan is an exceptional software engineer with 20 years of experience, strong engineering practices, and proven leadership, he is fundamentally misaligned with this role's core requirements. His C++ experience is dated (Dec 2014–June 2015, over 11 years ago) and limited to 6 months, while the last decade has been focused on web development with TypeScript and Node.js. Critical gaps include: no industrial automation or embedded systems background, no security expertise (SDL, IEC 62443), no MQTT or industrial protocol exposure, and no Azure or Python listed. The role explicitly requires 8–12 years of focused C++ development; this candidate's recent trajectory and expertise lie in a different domain.
strengths: Demonstrates exceptional software engineering practices including TDD, CI/CD, and clean architecture across 20 years of diverse technical roles
Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities evidenced by organizing workshops, building open-source communities (GISCollective), and team management at multiple senior positions
Highly adaptable with proven ability to master multiple programming languages and domains (web, mobile, embedded, distributed systems)
concerns: C++ expertise is significantly dated (2014–2015, 11+ years ago) and limited to 6 months; recent 11 years focused exclusively on TypeScript/Node.js, moving away from systems and performance-critical programming
Complete absence of security expertise (SDL, IEC 62443 standards) and industrial automation domain knowledge—both critical for this role in industrial manufacturing
Missing key technical competencies including MQTT protocol, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850), Azure cloud services, Python, and UML—all listed as core or advantageous requirements

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation, embedded systems, and security domain knowledge
General software craftsmanship and leadership capability
